text: By morning the fog had lifted, and there was a boat on the north rocks.
Nobody hurt. Nobody on board, either.
The harbour master, Dunn, had already decided whose fault it was.
Your lamp went out, Gus. I have three witnesses and a hole in a hull.
Three days. Prove it wasn’t you, or the council takes the key.
Gus said nothing. He was not thinking about the council.
He was thinking about the lamp. It had not failed. It had been switched off.
